name: @educateos/integrations
description: EducateOS interoperability adapters: OneRoster 1.2 roster sync from a bulk CSV export (as files or one ZIP) or a REST server, and Clever Data API v3.1 roster sync (complete and events delta) through the same pipeline: preview, identity linking, safe apply, a large-removal hold, delta sync runs with per-file or event cursors, stored sync state and run history (in memory or a Durable Object), a sync schedule and integration health. A library, not a deployable Worker.
